name: Close Link Deletion Request V 01
definition: The CloseLinkDeletionRequest message is sent by an instructing party to the executing party to request for the deletion of a close link in the executing system collateral management reference data.||Usage: |It aims at instructing the deletion of an existing close link with corresponding details.|Processing and confirmation of the close link creation request message are provided via a collateral management status advice.
